sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已上线，您可以在任何收听播客的平台上收听。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人不安的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用中本集节目的说明，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: Cindy Paulson stood alone on the corner of East 4th Avenue and Denali Street in downtown Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 辛迪·保尔森独自站在安克雷奇市中心东第四大道和德纳利街的拐角处。

sentences.en: Eighteen-year-old Cindy was a sex worker who frequented the city's infamous Tenderloin District.
sentences.zh: 18岁的辛迪是一名性工作者，经常出没于该市臭名昭著的“里脊肉区”（Tenderloin District）。

sentences.en: With its array of bars and clubs, the area was typically a hotbed of potential clients.
sentences.zh: 那里酒吧和俱乐部林立，通常是潜在客户的聚集地。

sentences.en: But so far, the night of Sunday June 12, 1983, had been a quiet one.
sentences.zh: 但截至1983年6月12日星期日那天晚上，生意一直很冷清。

sentences.en: Then, shortly before midnight, a green Buick Sentry pulled up to the kerb where Cindy stood.
sentences.zh: 午夜前不久，一辆绿色的别克世纪轿车停在了辛迪站立的路边。

sentences.en: The male driver peered up at her from behind a pair of thick-rimmed eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 男司机戴着一副粗框眼镜，从车里抬头看向她。

sentences.en: He propositioned Cindy and the pair began negotiating.
sentences.zh: 他向辛迪搭讪，两人开始讨价还价。

sentences.en: After they'd settled on a price, Cindy climbed into the car's passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 谈妥价格后，辛迪坐进了副驾驶座。

sentences.en: The man drove her to a secluded parking lot and turned off the engine.
sentences.zh: 男人开车把她带到一个偏僻的停车场，熄灭了引擎。

sentences.en: Within seconds, he'd produced a wood-handled .357 Magnum revolver.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，他掏出了一把木柄的.357马格南左轮手枪。

sentences.en: Aiming it at Cindy with one hand, he grabbed a pair of handcuffs from under his seat with the other.
sentences.zh: 他一手用枪指着辛迪，另一只手从座位下抓出一副手铐。

sentences.en: A smile crept across his pockmarked face as he restrained Cindy's wrists.
sentences.zh: 当他铐住辛迪的手腕时，他那张坑坑洼洼的脸上浮现出一抹微笑。

sentences.en: He drove east along the Glen Highway, where the city's lights and noise were soon replaced by the dark stillness of suburbia.
sentences.zh: 他沿着格伦公路向东行驶，城市的灯光和喧嚣很快被郊区黑暗的寂静所取代。

sentences.en: Turning down a cul-de-sac named Old Harbour Avenue, they passed several ranch-like family homes,
sentences.zh: 他们拐进一条名为“老港大道”的死胡同，经过了几栋牧场风格的家庭住宅，

sentences.en: before pulling into a driveway that led to a single-storey, blue-grey weatherboard house.
sentences.zh: 随后驶入一条车道，通向一栋单层、蓝灰色的木板房。

sentences.en: A pair of antlers hung above the door of a two-car garage.
sentences.zh: 双车位车库的门上方挂着一对鹿角。

sentences.en: To its right was the main living area, with several windows overlooking the front lawn.
sentences.zh: 右侧是主生活区，几扇窗户俯瞰着前院草坪。

sentences.en: No one stirred within.
sentences.zh: 屋内毫无动静。

sentences.en: The remainder of the spacious property was equally silent and still, shadowed by tall aspen and birch trees.
sentences.zh: 宽敞的房产其余部分同样寂静无声，笼罩在高大的白杨和桦树的阴影中。

sentences.en: Dragging Cindy inside the house, the man took her down some stairs into a wood-panelled basement.
sentences.zh: 男人把辛迪拖进屋里，带她走下楼梯，进入一个木镶板的地下室。

sentences.en: What first caught her attention were all the taxidermied animals and hunting trophies that filled the room.
sentences.zh: 首先引起她注意的是房间里塞满了各种动物标本和狩猎战利品。

sentences.en: Game birds, mountain goats, dull sheep and caribou had been stuffed and mounted throughout.
sentences.zh: 猎鸟、山羊、多尔羊和驯鹿的标本被制作并陈列在各处。

sentences.en: Walrus tusks and moose antlers decorated the walls.
sentences.zh: 海象牙和驼鹿角装饰着墙壁。

sentences.en: Beaver and wolf hides were scattered about.
sentences.zh: 海狸和狼的皮毛散落在地上。

sentences.en: On the floor was a bearskin rug.
sentences.zh: 地板上铺着一张熊皮地毯。

sentences.en: In a moment of crystal clear clarity, Cindy realised that she was trapped in the lair of a man who liked killing.
sentences.zh: 在那一瞬间，辛迪头脑异常清醒地意识到，她被困在了一个嗜杀成性的男人的巢穴里。

sentences.en: Retrieving a chain, the man wrapped it around Cindy's neck four times before locking it against a wooden support beam.
sentences.zh: 男人取来一条铁链，在辛迪脖子上缠了四圈，然后将其锁在木支撑梁上。

sentences.en: Then he raped her, before settling down for a nap on a nearby sofa.
sentences.zh: 随后他强奸了她，接着便在旁边的沙发上躺下小睡。

sentences.en: Pointing his revolver at Cindy, he warned her not to wake him or, quote,
sentences.zh: 他用左轮手枪指着辛迪，警告她不要吵醒他，否则，引用他的话：

sentences.en: You'll make me mad, and you don't want to see me mad.
sentences.zh: “你会惹我生气，而你绝对不想看到我生气的样子。”

sentences.en: While her captor slept, Cindy's mind raced.
sentences.zh: 当绑架者熟睡时，辛迪的大脑飞速运转。

sentences.en: Her eyes darted around the basement, taking in every detail.
sentences.zh: 她的目光在地下室里四处扫视，捕捉着每一个细节。

sentences.en: There was a pool table and foosball table, a television, a clock, a computer, a rack of women's clothing.
sentences.zh: 那里有台球桌、桌上足球、电视、时钟、电脑，还有一个挂满女装的衣架。

sentences.en: And all of those dead animals.
sentences.zh: 还有那些死去的动物。

sentences.en: Cindy knew with absolute certainty that they hadn't been her captor's only victiMs.
sentences.zh: 辛迪绝对肯定，这些并不是绑架者唯一的受害者。

sentences.en: She thought about grabbing one of the pool cues and hitting him over the head.
sentences.zh: 她想过抓起一根台球杆砸向他的头。

sentences.en: But what if he died?
sentences.zh: 但如果他死了怎么办？

sentences.en: She'd be trapped down there, still chained to the beam with no way of calling for help.
sentences.zh: 她会被困在那里，依然被锁在横梁上，无法求救。

sentences.en: Or worse, she might not hit him hard enough and he would kill her then and there.
sentences.zh: 或者更糟，如果她没能把他打晕，他会当场杀了她。

sentences.en: Instead, Cindy waited in silence until the man stirred awake.
sentences.zh: 于是，辛迪静静地等待着，直到男人醒来。

sentences.en: He unchained her, but kept the handcuffs secured around her wrists.
sentences.zh: 他解开了锁链，但仍让手铐锁在她的手腕上。

sentences.en: Under the static, lifeless stares of the animals perched around them, he bragged of his world record hunting success and showed off one of his trophies.
sentences.zh: 在周围动物标本那呆滞、毫无生气的注视下，他吹嘘着自己打破世界纪录的狩猎成就，并炫耀着其中一件战利品。

sentences.en: Then, he raped Cindy again on the bearskin rug.
sentences.zh: 随后，他在熊皮地毯上再次强奸了辛迪。

sentences.en: Afterwards, his conversation took an even more sinister turn.
sentences.zh: 事后，他的谈话变得更加阴险。

sentences.en: The man explained how he had brought seven other women to his house, all of whom he kept captive for a week.
sentences.zh: 男人解释说，他曾把另外七名女性带到这所房子里，并将她们每人都囚禁了一周。

sentences.en: In an attempt to appeal to his humanity, Cindy tearfully begged to be released so she could see her mother again.
sentences.zh: 为了唤起他的人性，辛迪含泪恳求他放了自己，让她能再见母亲一面。

sentences.en: Everything's gonna be okay, he reassured her.
sentences.zh: “一切都会好起来的，”他安慰她道。

sentences.en: I'm not going to hurt you.
sentences.zh: “我不会伤害你。”

sentences.en: He said that he'd only brought Cindy to his home because he wanted to get his money's worth.
sentences.zh: 他说他把辛迪带回家只是因为想“物有所值”。

sentences.en: But now he liked her so much that he wanted to take her to a remote cabin he owned where they could, quote, make love one more time before he let her go.
sentences.zh: 但现在他太喜欢她了，想带她去他拥有的一个偏远小屋，在那里他们可以，引用他的话，“在放她走之前再做一次爱”。

sentences.en: He owned a plane that he kept at Merrill Field Airport so they could fly out from there.
sentences.zh: 他在梅里尔机场有一架飞机，他们可以从那里飞走。

sentences.en: Cindy nodded along, pretending to be fine with his plan.
sentences.zh: 辛迪点头附和，假装接受了他的计划。

sentences.en: Yet, she knew the only way she was going to survive was if she found a way to escape.
sentences.zh: 然而，她知道自己唯一的生存机会就是找到逃跑的方法。

sentences.en: The sun hadn't yet risen when Cindy was led from the weatherboard house and back into the Buick.
sentences.zh: 天还没亮，辛迪就被带出了木板房，重新坐回了别克车里。

sentences.en: She was forced to lie down along the back seat where she was covered with an army blanket.
sentences.zh: 她被迫躺在后座上，身上盖着一条军用毯子。

sentences.en: As her captor drove, Cindy remembered that Merrill Field was right by the motel where she was staying with her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 当绑架者开车时，辛迪想起梅里尔机场就在她和男友住的汽车旅馆旁边。

sentences.en: If she managed to get away somehow, she wouldn't have to run far for help.
sentences.zh: 如果她能设法逃脱，她就不必跑太远去求救。

sentences.en: They arrived at the airport shortly before 5am.
sentences.zh: 他们在凌晨5点前不久到达了机场。

sentences.en: Private bush planes lined the acres of quiet, dark field.
sentences.zh: 私人丛林飞机停满了安静、黑暗的机场空地。

sentences.en: Cindy's captor pulled up near a blue and white two-seater supercub.
sentences.zh: 辛迪的绑架者在一架蓝白相间的双座超级幼兽飞机旁停下。

sentences.en: He got out and began loading the aircraft with things from the trunk of his car.
sentences.zh: 他下车开始把车后备箱里的东西搬上飞机。

sentences.en: Watching from the Buick as he walked back and forth, Cindy suddenly noticed that he'd left the driver's side door ajar.
sentences.zh: 辛迪在别克车里看着他来回走动，突然发现他把驾驶座的车门留了一条缝。

sentences.en: Overcome with nervous energy, she delicately removed her high-heeled shoes, put them aside, and waited.
sentences.zh: 她强压着紧张的情绪，小心翼翼地脱下高跟鞋放在一边，等待时机。

sentences.en: Once the man was over by his plane, Cindy clambered into the front seat and leapt out the open door.
sentences.zh: 当男人走到飞机旁时，辛迪爬到前座，从打开的车门跳了出去。

sentences.en: Racing barefoot over the gravel runway, Cindy heard the man shout behind her,
sentences.zh: 辛迪赤脚在碎石跑道上飞奔，听到身后男人大喊：

sentences.en: Stop, you bitch, or I'll kill you.
sentences.zh: “站住，你这婊子，不然我就杀了你。”

sentences.en: It took a moment for truck driver Robert Yount to register the strange sight before him.
sentences.zh: 卡车司机罗伯特·扬花了一会儿才意识到眼前这奇怪的一幕。

sentences.en: A young woman had bolted onto East Fifth Avenue, waving her handcuffed hands in the air and screaming for help.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻女子冲上了东第五大道，挥舞着戴着手铐的双手，尖叫着求救。

sentences.en: As she sprinted towards Robert's truck, he leaned over to open the passenger side door.
sentences.zh: 当她冲向罗伯特的卡车时，他探身打开了副驾驶车门。

sentences.en: Launching herself inside, the woman yelled,
sentences.zh: 女子钻进车里，大喊道：

sentences.en: He's going to kill me.
sentences.zh: “他要杀了我。”

sentences.en: Get me out of here.
sentences.zh: “快带我离开这里。”

sentences.en: According to the book Fair Game, Robert scanned the airfield where the woman had come from, but couldn't see who she was referring to.
sentences.zh: 根据《公平游戏》一书的记载，罗伯特扫视了女子跑来的机场方向，但没看到她所指的人。

sentences.en: His distressed passenger begged him to hurry, so Robert drove onwards.
sentences.zh: 他那惊恐的乘客恳求他快点走，于是罗伯特继续开车。

sentences.en: She asked to be taken to a nearby motel and Robert obliged, pulling over at the Mush Inn, a low-budget motel 450 feet from Merrill Field.
sentences.zh: 她要求去附近的汽车旅馆，罗伯特照办了，在距离梅里尔机场450英尺的一家低价旅馆——蘑菇旅馆（Mush Inn）停了下来。

sentences.en: The woman rushed inside.
sentences.zh: 女子冲了进去。

sentences.en: Bewildered, Robert continued driving to work.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特感到困惑，继续开车去上班。

sentences.en: As soon as he got there, he called the Anchorage Police Department.
sentences.zh: 一到公司，他就给安克雷奇警察局打了电话。

sentences.en: Ten-year police veteran Greg Baker was halfway through his shift when he got the call to attend the Mush Inn.
sentences.zh: 有十年警龄的格雷格·贝克警官在值班期间接到了前往蘑菇旅馆的指令。

sentences.en: By the time he arrived, the handcuffed woman had left in a taxi.
sentences.zh: 等他赶到时，那名戴着手铐的女子已经乘出租车离开了。

sentences.en: She was traced to another motel down the road named The Big Timber.
sentences.zh: 警方追踪到她去了路边的另一家旅馆，名叫“大木材”（The Big Timber）。

sentences.en: When Officer Baker got there, a front desk clerk directed him to room 110.
sentences.zh: 当贝克警官赶到那里时，前台接待员指引他去了110房间。

sentences.en: He knocked on the door and a young woman answered.
sentences.zh: 他敲了敲门，一名年轻女子开了门。

sentences.en: She was barefoot and her wrists were red and raw from the handcuffs still clasped around them.
sentences.zh: 她赤着脚，手腕上因为还戴着手铐而红肿破皮。

sentences.en: Her name was Cindy Paulson.
sentences.zh: 她叫辛迪·保尔森。

sentences.en: After hearing of her ordeal, Officer Baker escorted Cindy to hospital to undergo an examination.
sentences.zh: 在听完她的遭遇后，贝克警官护送辛迪去医院接受检查。

sentences.en: As they drove by Merrill Field, she insisted on showing him her assailant's aircraft.
sentences.zh: 当他们开车经过梅里尔机场时，她坚持要带他去看袭击者的飞机。

sentences.en: She singled out a blue and white supercub, which bore a registration number on its tail, written as small as regulations allowed.
sentences.zh: 她指认了一架蓝白相间的超级幼兽飞机，其尾部写着符合法规要求的最小尺寸的注册号。

sentences.en: Upon cross-checking the plane's registration, police discovered it belonged to a man who lived at the Old Harbour Avenue address where Cindy said she had been held captive.
sentences.zh: 经核对飞机注册信息，警方发现它属于一名男子，该男子就住在辛迪所说的囚禁她的老港大道地址。

sentences.en: Police rushed to the blue-grey weatherboard house, only to discover that no one was home.
sentences.zh: 警察冲进那栋蓝灰色的木板房，却发现家里没人。

sentences.en: They stood guard over the property and waited.
sentences.zh: 他们在房产外守候。

sentences.en: Shortly before 7am, a green Buick sentry pulled into the driveway.
sentences.zh: 凌晨7点前不久，一辆绿色的别克世纪轿车驶入车道。

sentences.en: Officers descended on the vehicle and its driver, 44-year-old Robert Hanson.
sentences.zh: 警察迅速包围了车辆及其驾驶员——44岁的罗伯特·汉森。

sentences.en: Originally from Iowa, Hanson had moved to Alaska with his wife in 1963.
sentences.zh: 汉森原籍爱荷华州，1963年随妻子搬到阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: The couple settled in Anchorage, where they had two children.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在安克雷奇定居，育有两个孩子。

sentences.en: Hanson had followed in his father's footsteps by becoming a baker and owned the business Hanson's Bakery a few blocks from downtown.
sentences.zh: 汉森子承父业成为一名面包师，并在市中心附近开了家“汉森面包店”。

sentences.en: Anchorage police were very familiar with Robert Hanson, known locally as Bob.
sentences.zh: 安克雷奇警方对罗伯特·汉森非常熟悉，当地人称他为“鲍勃”。

sentences.en: His bakery wasn't far from the station, so they visited often for coffee and doughnuts.
sentences.zh: 他的面包店离警局不远，所以警察经常去那里买咖啡和甜甜圈。

sentences.en: Hanson was, by all accounts, a stable and religious family man.
sentences.zh: 据各方评价，汉森是一个稳定且虔诚的顾家男人。

sentences.en: During his youth, he had been enlisted in the US military and he'd since become an active member of the community.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，他曾应征入伍，此后一直是一名积极的社区成员。

sentences.en: Hanson was unarmed when police surrounded his vehicle.
sentences.zh: 警察包围车辆时，汉森身上没有武器。

sentences.en: Calmly, he asked them,
sentences.zh: 他平静地问他们：

sentences.en: What can I do for you, officers?
sentences.zh: “警官，我能为您做些什么吗？”

sentences.en: Cindy Paulson had accurately detailed his appearance and even knew of his stutter.
sentences.zh: 辛迪·保尔森准确地描述了他的外貌，甚至知道他有口吃。

sentences.en: A bright green baseball cap and green coat was spotted in his car, matching what Cindy said he was wearing when he picked her up.
sentences.zh: 车里发现了一顶亮绿色的棒球帽和一件绿色外套，与辛迪所说他接她时穿的衣服相符。

sentences.en: Her descriptions of his house, inside and out, were also spot on.
sentences.zh: 她对房子内外结构的描述也完全准确。

sentences.en: Hanson signed a waiver allowing police to search his car, home and aircraft.
sentences.zh: 汉森签署了同意书，允许警方搜查他的汽车、房屋和飞机。

sentences.en: There was nothing of evidentiary value in his Buick.
sentences.zh: 他的别克车里没有任何有价值的证据。

sentences.en: Cindy's shoes, which she had left behind as evidence of her presence, were not in the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 辛迪留下的作为证据的鞋子并没有在车里。

sentences.en: There was nothing to prove she'd been held captive in Hanson's house either.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何证据证明她曾被囚禁在汉森的房子里。

sentences.en: The basement full of hunting paraphernalia was just as Cindy described, but there was no wooden beam like the one she'd said she was chained to overnight,
sentences.zh: 地下室里确实像辛迪描述的那样摆满了狩猎用品，但并没有她所说的那种用来锁住她过夜的木横梁，

sentences.en: nor was there even a chain.
sentences.zh: 也没有铁链。

sentences.en: Also missing were a yellow towel and washcloth Cindy claimed to have used.
sentences.zh: 辛迪声称使用过的黄色毛巾和洗脸巾也不见了。

sentences.en: A search of Hanson's supercub was equally anticlimactic.
sentences.zh: 对汉森超级幼兽飞机的搜查同样令人失望。

sentences.en: Hanson was an award-winning trophy hunter who owned an array of pistols, rifles and shotguns.
sentences.zh: 汉森是一位屡获殊荣的战利品猎人，拥有各种手枪、步枪和猎枪。

sentences.en: But none matched the wood-handled revolver used against Cindy.
sentences.zh: 但没有一把与对辛迪使用的那把木柄左轮手枪相符。

sentences.en: Hanson agreed to be interviewed and was polite and cooperative throughout.
sentences.zh: 汉森同意接受审讯，全程表现得礼貌且配合。

sentences.en: He denied abducting or raping Cindy Paulson and had an alibi to prove it.
sentences.zh: 他否认绑架或强奸了辛迪·保尔森，并有不在场证明。

sentences.en: Half an hour before Cindy was abducted, Hanson went to the home of a friend named John Henning.
sentences.zh: 在辛迪被绑架前半小时，汉森去了朋友约翰·亨宁的家。

sentences.en: He remained there all night, staying up with John until 5.30am drinking beer and planning a fishing trip.
sentences.zh: 他整晚都待在那里，和约翰一直待到凌晨5点半，喝啤酒并计划钓鱼之旅。

sentences.en: Afterwards, they headed to Meryl Field to install a seat in Hanson's supercub.
sentences.zh: 之后，他们前往梅里尔机场为汉森的超级幼兽飞机安装座椅。

sentences.en: John Henning confirmed Hanson's assertions.
sentences.zh: 约翰·亨宁证实了汉森的说法。

sentences.en: A physical examination of Cindy Paulson revealed evidence of vaginal penetration along with the presence of semen.
sentences.zh: 对辛迪·保尔森的身体检查显示了阴道穿透的证据以及精液的存在。

sentences.en: But the examining doctor told investigators that Cindy only had abrasions around her wrists, not her neck, where she said a chain had been looped.
sentences.zh: 但检查医生告诉调查人员，辛迪只有手腕周围有擦伤，脖子上并没有她所说的铁链缠绕痕迹。

sentences.en: Despite this, Cindy maintained her version of events.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，辛迪仍坚持自己的说法。

sentences.en: With Hanson's whereabouts fully accounted for, investigators presumed that Cindy was lying in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 由于汉森的行踪完全有据可查，调查人员推测辛迪在某些方面撒了谎。

sentences.en: It was clear from her accurate description of both Robert Hanson and his property that Cindy knew him in some way, likely through her sex work.
sentences.zh: 从她对罗伯特·汉森及其房产的准确描述来看，很明显辛迪以某种方式认识他，很可能是通过她的性工作。

sentences.en: But, whatever had happened to her the previous night, it couldn't have been at his hands.
sentences.zh: 但是，无论前一天晚上她遭遇了什么，都不可能是他干的。

sentences.en: She likely did meet with a client, though the ordeal she described didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 她很可能确实见过一位客户，但她描述的遭遇却对不上号。

sentences.en: While Hanson was cagey about any history he might have had with Cindy Paulson, she was adamant that they had met once before.
sentences.zh: 虽然汉森对与辛迪·保尔森的过往历史守口如瓶，但她坚称他们之前见过一次。

sentences.en: Cindy mentioned that Hanson had propositioned her previously from his Buick.
sentences.zh: 辛迪提到汉森之前曾开着别克车向她搭讪。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Fair Game, he had introduced himself using a different name.
sentences.zh: 正如《公平游戏》一书中所述，他当时用了另一个名字介绍自己。

sentences.en: The two arranged to meet the night before her abduction, but he was a no-show.
sentences.zh: 两人约定在绑架前一天晚上见面，但他没出现。

sentences.en: This prompted police to wonder whether Cindy harboured resentment towards Hanson for standing her up and costing her income.
sentences.zh: 这让警方怀疑辛迪是否因为汉森放鸽子导致她损失收入而怀恨在心。

sentences.en: Was she implicating him in a crime for revenge?
sentences.zh: 她是为了报复而陷害他吗？

sentences.en: Skeptical investigators believed that this was a classic case of a sex worker getting into a disagreement with a client over money.
sentences.zh: 持怀疑态度的调查人员认为，这只是一个典型的性工作者与客户因钱产生纠纷的案例。

sentences.en: What police described as, quote,

sentences.en: A trick gone awry.
sentences.zh: “一场搞砸的交易。”

sentences.en: Cindy was asked to sit a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 辛迪被要求参加测谎测试。

sentences.en: She skipped town with her boyfriend the very next day, never taking the test or informing police of her decision.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她就和男友离开了小镇，再也没有参加测试，也没有通知警方她的决定。

sentences.en: This confirmed their suspicions that her version of events were heavily fabricated.
sentences.zh: 这证实了他们的怀疑，即她对事件的描述经过了严重的捏造。

sentences.en: By late June, the case was officially closed.
sentences.zh: 到六月下旬，此案已正式结案。

sentences.en: A note on its file stipulated that no further action was required.
sentences.zh: 案卷上的一条备注规定，无需采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》节目稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商内容，以此支持我们。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Despite this, Greg Baker of Anchorage PD's sexual assault unit never wavered in his belief that Cindy Paulson had been telling the truth about Robert Hanson.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，安克雷奇警察局性侵犯部门的格雷格·贝克警官始终坚信，辛迪·保尔森关于罗伯特·汉森的陈述是真实的。

sentences.en: Having heard her story first hand and witnessed her obvious distress, his instincts told him she was genuine.
sentences.zh: 在亲耳听过她的讲述并目睹了她明显的痛苦后，他的直觉告诉他，她所言非虚。

sentences.en: While his colleagues were quick to dismiss Cindy's assertions based on a few uncertain details, there were overlooked or disregarded clues that hinted at Hanson's guilt.
sentences.zh: 虽然他的同事们仅凭几个不确定的细节就迅速驳回了辛迪的指控，但仍有一些被忽视或被无视的线索暗示了汉森的罪行。

sentences.en: At the time of the attack, Hanson's wife and children were vacationing overseas, which gave him full reign of the house.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生时，汉森的妻子和孩子们正在海外度假，这让他可以完全掌控这栋房子。

sentences.en: His alibi had come from one of his long-time hunting and fishing friends, not exactly an unbiased and trustworthy third party.
sentences.zh: 他的不在场证明来自他的一位长期狩猎和钓鱼的朋友，这显然不是一个公正且值得信赖的第三方。

sentences.en: And while most people who faced such serious accusations were outraged or indignant,
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数面临如此严重指控的人都会感到愤怒或愤慨，

sentences.en: Hanson softly and confidently rebutted the crimes levelled against him.
sentences.zh: 汉森却轻声且自信地反驳了针对他的罪名。

sentences.en: Then, there was a statement given by a Merrill Field security guard on duty the morning Cindy said she was taken there.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一名在辛迪所说被带到那里的那天早上值班的梅里尔机场保安提供的证词。

sentences.en: He had seen a green Buick Sentry arriving at around 5am and watched it move to a corner of the airfield.
sentences.zh: 他看到一辆绿色的别克哨兵轿车在凌晨5点左右到达，并看着它驶向机场的一个角落。

sentences.en: This correlated with Cindy's story.
sentences.zh: 这与辛迪的说法相吻合。

sentences.en: Shortly thereafter, a man wearing a green coat and bright green baseball cap ran out from behind a blue and white Super Cub plane.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，一名身穿绿色外套、戴着亮绿色棒球帽的男子从一架蓝白相间的超级幼兽飞机后面跑了出来。

sentences.en: Upon noticing the security guard observing him, the man slowed to a walk, returned to the Buick, got in, and sped off along East 5th Avenue.
sentences.zh: 当注意到保安在观察他时，该男子放慢脚步改为步行，回到别克车上，上车后沿着东第五大道疾驰而去。

sentences.en: Sensing Robert Hanson was his guy, Officer Baker trawled through police records to see what he could uncover.
sentences.zh: 感觉到罗伯特·汉森就是他要找的人，贝克警官开始搜查警方记录，看看能发现什么。

sentences.en: To his surprise, Hanson's file was extensive.
sentences.zh: 令他惊讶的是，汉森的档案非常丰富。

sentences.en: He'd spent short stints in prison throughout his life for a range of offences.
sentences.zh: 他一生中曾因各种罪行多次短暂入狱。

sentences.en: In 1960, Hanson, who was then around 20 years old, received his first conviction.
sentences.zh: 1960年，当时20岁左右的汉森第一次被定罪。

sentences.en: He pleaded guilty to arson after setting fire to a bus garage belonging to his former high school.
sentences.zh: 他在纵火烧毁了他母校的一间校车车库后承认了纵火罪。

sentences.en: Due to Hanson's stutter and severe acne, his high school experience had been marred with bullying, taunts, and rejection.
sentences.zh: 由于汉森口吃且患有严重的痤疮，他的高中生活充满了欺凌、嘲讽和排斥。

sentences.en: This had fuelled his desire to seek revenge against the institution.
sentences.zh: 这助长了他对该机构进行报复的欲望。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: Hanson was sentenced to three years at a state reformatory, where he was diagnosed with an infantile and antisocial personality.
sentences.zh: 汉森被判处在州教养所服刑三年，在那里他被诊断出患有幼稚型人格和反社会人格。

sentences.en: This was deemed to be the result of a strict upbringing and low self-esteem, inflamed by the torment of his peers.
sentences.zh: 这被认为是严厉的教养方式和低自尊的结果，并因同龄人的折磨而加剧。

sentences.en: While incarcerated, he spoke of having vengeful and destructive fantasies, some of which featured girls who'd rejected his advances or made fun of him.
sentences.zh: 在服刑期间，他谈到自己有复仇和破坏性的幻想，其中一些幻想的对象是那些拒绝过他或嘲笑过他的女孩。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: It's hard to explain what it's like to always be wanting, to see others go out on dates.
sentences.zh: 很难解释那种总是渴望得到什么、看着别人去约会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I was just seeing everybody else get theirs.
sentences.zh: 我只是看着别人得到了他们想要的。

sentences.en: Hanson soon realised that speaking honestly about his mental demons only hindered his parole efforts.
sentences.zh: 汉森很快意识到，诚实地谈论他内心的恶魔只会阻碍他的假释申请。

sentences.en: So he started to play the system by portraying himself as rehabilitated and harmless.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始玩弄体制，将自己伪装成已经改过自新且无害的人。

sentences.en: Although he was unable to fully suppress his infantile personality, Hanson could hide his antisocial attitudes.
sentences.zh: 尽管他无法完全压制自己的幼稚人格，但汉森可以隐藏他的反社会态度。

sentences.en: Doing so, coupled with his record of good conduct, led to his parole in 1963.
sentences.zh: 这样做，加上他良好的表现记录，使他在1963年获得了假释。

sentences.en: Yet, Robert Hanson never managed to stay out of trouble for long.
sentences.zh: 然而，罗伯特·汉森从未能长时间保持安分守己。

sentences.en: After stealing a chainsaw from a shop, he was diagnosed with bipolar affective disorder.
sentences.zh: 在从商店偷走一把电锯后，他被诊断出患有双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: The courts ruled he needed an ongoing routine of medication and therapy to overcome his behavioural probleMs.
sentences.zh: 法院裁定他需要持续的药物治疗和心理辅导来克服他的行为问题。

sentences.en: But Hanson received neither.
sentences.zh: 但汉森两者都没得到。

sentences.en: It was a series of crimes Hanson committed in late 1971 that really drew Officer Greg Baker's attention.
sentences.zh: 汉森在1971年底犯下的一系列罪行才真正引起了格雷格·贝克警官的注意。

sentences.en: The first was the attempted abduction of a woman from her Anchorage apartment.
sentences.zh: 第一起是企图从安克雷奇的公寓中绑架一名女子。

sentences.en: Hanson had made eye contact with her at a set of traffic lights and followed her home to ask her out.
sentences.zh: 汉森在红绿灯处与她有过眼神接触，并跟踪她回家想约她出去。

sentences.en: She rejected him and a week later, he confronted her at gunpoint with the intention of taking her elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了他，一周后，他持枪与她对峙，意图将她带到别处。

sentences.en: His plan was interrupted by the police and Hanson was charged with assault with a deadly weapon.
sentences.zh: 他的计划被警察打断，汉森被控持致命武器袭击罪。

sentences.en: He was released on bail, during which time he successfully abducted a second woman from outside an Anchorage coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 他被保释出狱，在此期间，他成功地从安克雷奇一家咖啡店外绑架了第二名女子。

sentences.en: She was driven outside the city by the gun-wielding Hanson, who kept her bound as he repeatedly assaulted and raped her.
sentences.zh: 她被持枪的汉森开车带出城外，汉森将她捆绑起来，并反复对她进行殴打和强奸。

sentences.en: At one point, he spoke of taking her to a remote cabin, though he was unable to reach it due to snow on the road.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他提到要带她去一个偏僻的小木屋，但由于路上积雪，他没能到达那里。

sentences.en: The charges against him in relation to this case were ultimately dropped, but the similarities between this incident and what later happened to Cindy Paulson were cleared.
sentences.zh: 针对他此案的指控最终被撤销，但这次事件与后来发生在辛迪·保尔森身上的事情之间的相似之处已得到证实。

sentences.en: There were many other instances in which Hanson had threatened or harmed women, though nothing came of these reports.
sentences.zh: 汉森威胁或伤害女性的例子还有很多，尽管这些报告最终都不了了之。

sentences.en: Most of his misbehaviour centred around the Tenderloin District and involved dancers or sex workers.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的不当行为都集中在田德隆区，涉及舞女或性工作者。

sentences.en: Some of his survivors opted not to go to police in fear of retribution from Hanson.
sentences.zh: 一些幸存者因害怕汉森的报复而选择不报警。

sentences.en: Others were brushed aside by a system mired in victim-blaming and discrimination.
sentences.zh: 其他人则被一个深陷受害者有罪论和歧视的体制所忽视。

sentences.en: One night, police were called to the Great Alaskan Bush Company, one of Hanson's many regular haunts.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，警方接到报警前往“大阿拉斯加丛林公司”，这是汉森经常出没的地方之一。

sentences.en: Upon arrival, officers found Hanson and a dancer, Judy Russell, arguing out the front.
sentences.zh: 到达后，警察发现汉森和一名舞女朱迪·拉塞尔正在店门前争吵。

sentences.en: According to reports, Judy had jumped off stage mid-performance and began clawing and kicking at Hanson.
sentences.zh: 据报道，朱迪在表演中途跳下舞台，开始抓挠和踢打汉森。

sentences.en: She told attending officers that Hanson had recently abducted her at gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 她告诉到场的警察，汉森最近持枪绑架了她。

sentences.en: At that time, Judy worked at a club called Embers, and Hanson had propositioned her for sex in exchange for money.
sentences.zh: 当时，朱迪在一家名为“余烬”的俱乐部工作，汉森曾向她提出用钱换取性服务。

sentences.en: What followed was a harrowing ordeal, during which Hanson bound Judy in his camper pick-up and attempted to drive her out of the city.
sentences.zh: 随后发生了一场令人痛苦的折磨，期间汉森将朱迪捆绑在他的皮卡露营车里，并试图开车将她带出城。

sentences.en: Judy was able to escape, but at the time, she couldn't recall any key identifying details about her abductor.
sentences.zh: 朱迪设法逃脱了，但当时她无法回忆起关于绑架者的任何关键特征。

sentences.en: Following this frightening ordeal, Judy left Embers and started dancing at the Great Alaskan Bush Company.
sentences.zh: 在那次可怕的经历后，朱迪离开了“余烬”，开始在“大阿拉斯加丛林公司”跳舞。

sentences.en: When Robert Hanson happened to show up there, she immediately recognised his pockmarked, bespectacled face and launched herself at him in anger.
sentences.zh: 当罗伯特·汉森碰巧出现在那里时，她立刻认出了他那张满是痘痕、戴着眼镜的脸，并愤怒地冲向他。

sentences.en: Hanson didn't deny knowing Judy, but disputed her version of events.
sentences.zh: 汉森并不否认认识朱迪，但对她描述的事件版本提出了异议。

sentences.en: He agreed that he had offered her money in exchange for sex acts, but denied abducting her.
sentences.zh: 他承认曾提出给她钱以换取性行为，但否认绑架了她。

sentences.en: Hanson had made a similar excuse when a dancer from the Kit Kat club accused him of abducting and raping her at gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 当“猫咪”俱乐部的一名舞女指控他持枪绑架并强奸她时，汉森也找过类似的借口。

sentences.en: It was clear that he held dancers and sex workers in poor regard.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他非常看不起舞女和性工作者。

sentences.en: Despite multiple women having made near-identical allegations against Hanson over a 12-year period, they were ignored.
sentences.zh: 尽管在12年间有多名女性对汉森提出了几乎相同的指控，但她们都被忽视了。

sentences.en: Police trusted Hanson, who had moulded himself into an upstanding citizen, albeit with a penchant for visiting strip clubs and hiring sex workers.
sentences.zh: 警方信任汉森，他把自己塑造成了一个正派公民，尽管他有去脱衣舞俱乐部和雇佣性工作者的嗜好。

sentences.en: Hanson didn't deny he was unfaithful to his wife, but he didn't want his family to find out.
sentences.zh: 汉森并不否认他对妻子不忠，但他不想让家人发现。

sentences.en: The police obliged by not pursuing the incident with Judy Russell any further.
sentences.zh: 警方顺从地没有再继续追究朱迪·拉塞尔的那起事件。

sentences.en: By the time Robert Hanson was on Officer Greg Baker's radar, he was a master manipulator who knew how to influence police.
sentences.zh: 当罗伯特·汉森进入格雷格·贝克警官的视野时，他已经是一个知道如何影响警方的操纵大师。

sentences.en: He made note of what led to his incarceration in the past, and now fully understood the importance of a good reputation,
sentences.zh: 他记住了过去导致他入狱的原因，现在完全理解了良好声誉的重要性，

sentences.en: the appearance of mental stability, procuring alibis, and targeting victims who were unreliable in the eyes of authority.
sentences.zh: 包括表现出心理稳定、寻找不在场证明，以及针对那些在权威眼中不可靠的受害者。

sentences.en: He fostered a successful business and home life, presenting himself as a well-respected, community-focused everyman.
sentences.zh: 他经营着成功的生意和家庭生活，将自己表现为一个受人尊敬、关注社区的普通人。

sentences.en: The last person anyone would suspect of doing harm.
sentences.zh: 他是任何人最不会怀疑会做坏事的人。

sentences.en: But, as far as Officer Baker was concerned, Hanson wasn't just a serial sex offender.
sentences.zh: 但是，在贝克警官看来，汉森不仅仅是一个连环性犯罪者。

sentences.en: During the Cindy Paulson investigation, Hanson's Buick had been searched.
sentences.zh: 在辛迪·保尔森的调查过程中，汉森的别克车曾被搜查过。

sentences.en: .223 ammunition was located under the driver's seat and rolled-up elastic bandages were spotted on the dashboard.
sentences.zh: 在驾驶座下发现了.223口径弹药，仪表盘上还发现了卷起来的弹性绷带。

sentences.en: Baker was aware of the murder of Sherry Morrow, whose bullet-riddled remains were found the previous year, partially buried in a sandbar spanning the Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 贝克知道雪莉·莫罗的谋杀案，她的遗体于去年被发现，身上布满弹孔，被部分掩埋在基尼克河的一处沙洲中。

sentences.en: Sherry had been blindfolded with an elastic bandage, then shot with a .223 calibre bullet.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被弹性绷带蒙住眼睛，然后被.223口径的子弹射杀。

sentences.en: As was Paula Goulding, who was also found in a shallow grave by the Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 宝拉·古尔丁也是如此，她也被发现在基尼克河边的一个浅坟里。

sentences.en: Given Hanson's keen interest in hunting, and his award-winning skill,
sentences.zh: 考虑到汉森对狩猎的浓厚兴趣，以及他那获奖级别的技术，

sentences.en: Baker was certain he was the serial killer who had been killing women in the wilderness surrounding Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 贝克确信他就是那个一直在安克雷奇周边荒野中杀害女性的连环杀手。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Hanson was carrying out his own fantasy version of The Most Dangerous Game.
sentences.zh: 看起来汉森是在现实中上演他自己幻想版本的《最危险的游戏》。

sentences.en: The phrase came from a short story by Richard Connell, in which a big game hunter grows bored with the pastime and decides to hunt humans instead.
sentences.zh: 这个短语来自理查德·康奈尔的短篇小说，讲述了一名大型猎物猎人对这项消遣感到厌倦，决定转而猎杀人类的故事。

sentences.en: The fictional character would release his captives into the wilderness, pursue them, then gun them down.
sentences.zh: 小说中的角色会将俘虏释放到荒野中，追捕他们，然后将他们枪杀。

sentences.en: Robert Hanson's criminal history showed an escalation in violence, and Officer Baker saw how this trajectory could result in murder.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·汉森的犯罪记录显示他的暴力行为在升级，贝克警官看到了这种轨迹是如何导致谋杀的。

sentences.en: He put together a report on everything he had discovered about Robert Hanson and delivered it to the Alaska State Troopers' headquarters,
sentences.zh: 他整理了一份关于他所发现的关于罗伯特·汉森的一切的报告，并将其提交给了阿拉斯加州警总部，

sentences.en: where it wound up in the hands of Sergeant Glenn Flothie.
sentences.zh: 在那里，报告落入了格伦·弗洛西警官手中。

sentences.en: The sergeant was able to track down Cindy Paulson for an interview.
sentences.zh: 这位警官成功找到了辛迪·保尔森进行面谈。

sentences.en: She told him she was certain that Robert Hanson had been her abductor, and was certain she would have been murdered had she not escaped at Merrill Field Airport.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她确信罗伯特·汉森就是绑架她的人，并且确信如果她没有在梅里尔机场逃脱，她肯定已经被谋杀了。

sentences.en: Sergeant Flothie, like Greg Baker before him, firmly believed Cindy.
sentences.zh: 弗洛西警官和之前的格雷格·贝克一样，坚定地相信辛迪。

sentences.en: And the suspect profile of the serial killer prowling Anchorage that had been provided by the FBI's Behavioural Sciences Unit, matched Hanson to a tee.
sentences.zh: 而且，联邦调查局行为科学部提供的在安克雷奇徘徊的连环杀手的嫌疑人画像，与汉森完全吻合。

sentences.en: On October 27, 1983, two plainclothes police sergeants arrived at a squat, single-storey building on the corner of East 9th Avenue and Ingera Street in Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 1983年10月27日，两名便衣警官来到安克雷奇东第九大道和因格拉街拐角处的一栋低矮的单层建筑前。

sentences.en: Merrill Field was just a few minutes' drive east, while the Tenderloin District was a short distance weSt.
sentences.zh: 梅里尔机场就在东边几分钟车程的地方，而田德隆区则在西边不远处。

sentences.en: It was approaching 8.30am when the officers approached a shop front with a sign above it that read,
sentences.zh: 快到早上8点30分时，警官们走近一个店面，上面的招牌写着：

sentences.en: Hanson's Bakery.
sentences.zh: 汉森烘焙坊。

sentences.en: Nearby, a man in a white baker's uniform and apron was collecting something from a car.
sentences.zh: 附近，一名穿着白色烘焙师制服和围裙的男子正在从车里拿东西。

sentences.en: The officers approached him and asked,
sentences.zh: 警官们走近他并问道：

sentences.en: Robert Hanson.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·汉森？

sentences.en: Hanson turned to face them.
sentences.zh: 汉森转过身面对他们。

sentences.en: They asked if he would be willing to talk with them about some cases under investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们问他是否愿意和他们谈谈一些正在调查的案件。

sentences.en: Sure, Hanson replied.
sentences.zh: “当然，”汉森回答。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book Butcher Baker,
sentences.zh: 正如书《屠夫面包师》中所详述的那样，

sentences.en: Glenn Flothie had gone to a lot of effort to set up the interview room just so.
sentences.zh: 格伦·弗洛西花了很多心思来布置审讯室。

sentences.en: Crime scene photos and pictures of the victims were arranged on a desk alongside stacks of manila folders.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场照片和受害者的照片被排列在桌子上，旁边是一叠叠的马尼拉文件夹。

sentences.en: Some of the files were labelled with names of Hanson's hunting associates.
sentences.zh: 一些档案上贴着汉森狩猎伙伴的名字。

sentences.en: A large map of the K'nick River Valley was pinned to a wall.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着一张巨大的基尼克河谷地图。

sentences.en: Two X marks had been drawn inside a large circle.
sentences.zh: 一个大圆圈内画了两个X标记。

sentences.en: Scrawled in all capital letters next to this were the words,
sentences.zh: 旁边用全大写字母潦草地写着：

sentences.en: Hanson identified in this area.
sentences.zh: 汉森在此区域被识别。

sentences.en: After being escorted into the room,
sentences.zh: 在被护送进房间后，

sentences.en: Hanson was left there alone for a little while so he could take it all in.
sentences.zh: 汉森被独自留在那里一会儿，以便他能看清这一切。

sentences.en: Soon, Glenn Flothie strode into the room and began his interrogation.
sentences.zh: 很快，格伦·弗洛西大步走进房间，开始了审讯。

sentences.en: Although Hanson admitted to having a criminal record, he insisted that was all in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 尽管汉森承认有犯罪记录，但他坚称那都是过去的事了。

sentences.en: Questioning dragged on for hours, covering every aspect of Hanson's history, from his initial charges of arson and theft, to the allegations of abduction and rape.
sentences.zh: 审讯持续了几个小时，涵盖了汉森历史的方方面面，从他最初的纵火和盗窃指控，到绑架和强奸的指控。

sentences.en: Interviewing officers stopped short of mentioning the murders.
sentences.zh: 审讯警官没有提及谋杀案。

sentences.en: For now.
sentences.zh: 暂时没有。

sentences.en: They discussed Hanson's first known offence against a woman, the botched abduction of an Anchorage teenager from her apartment in 1971.
sentences.zh: 他们讨论了汉森第一起已知的针对女性的罪行，即1971年从公寓中绑架一名安克雷奇少女未遂的案件。

sentences.en: When apprehended for this crime,
sentences.zh: 当因这起罪行被捕时，

sentences.en: Hanson claimed he had blacked out and therefore had no recollection of the event.
sentences.zh: 汉森声称他当时断片了，因此对这件事没有任何记忆。

sentences.en: As he sat before Sergeant Flothie in an interrogation room adorned with the faces of missing or murdered women,
sentences.zh: 当他坐在弗洛西警官面前，面对着装饰着失踪或被谋杀女性照片的审讯室时，

sentences.en: Hanson admitted that he had never really suffered any memory blackout in his life.
sentences.zh: 汉森承认他一生中从未真正经历过任何记忆断片。

sentences.en: According to the book Fair Game, this admission likely stemmed from Hanson knowing he wouldn't face any consequences for revealing the truth more than a decade later.
sentences.zh: 根据《公平游戏》一书，这种承认很可能源于汉森知道在十多年后揭露真相不会面临任何后果。

sentences.en: But it did expose him as a liar.
sentences.zh: 但这确实暴露了他是一个骗子。

sentences.en: Soon, the line of questioning turned to Sherry Morrow.
sentences.zh: 很快，审讯转向了雪莉·莫罗。

sentences.en: When shown a photograph of the murdered 23-year-old,
sentences.zh: 当被出示那名被谋杀的23岁女孩的照片时，

sentences.en: Hanson asked,
sentences.zh: 汉森问道：

sentences.en: Who's that?
sentences.zh: “那是谁？”

sentences.en: He refused to admit any knowledge of her murder or Paula Goulding's.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝承认对她的谋杀或宝拉·古尔丁的谋杀有任何了解。

sentences.en: He did say that he occasionally visited the areas where their bodies were found, before adding, I didn't shoot anybody.
sentences.zh: 他确实说他偶尔会去发现她们尸体的区域，然后补充道：“我没有枪杀任何人。”

sentences.en: I would not hurt anybody.
sentences.zh: “我不会伤害任何人。”

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商内容，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, police swarmed Robert Hanson's home and workplace to execute a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方蜂拥至罗伯特·汉森的家和工作场所执行搜查令。

sentences.en: Word of their presence quickly spread to the disbelief of his family and friends.
sentences.zh: 他们出现的消息迅速传开，令他的家人和朋友感到难以置信。

sentences.en: They had yet to learn why authorities had honed in on the seemingly stable and neighbourly Hanson and couldn't comprehend the idea that he might be in trouble with the law.
sentences.zh: 他们还不知道为什么当局会盯上看似稳定且友善的汉森，也无法理解他可能会触犯法律的想法。

sentences.en: The police activity soon piqued the interest of Joan, the wife of Hanson's close friend, John Henning.
sentences.zh: 警方的行动很快引起了汉森好友约翰·亨宁的妻子琼的注意。

sentences.en: She wondered whether their efforts related to something her husband had told her several months earlier.
sentences.zh: 她想知道他们的行动是否与她丈夫几个月前告诉她的一件事有关。

sentences.en: Shortly after a panicked Cindy Paulson had run handcuffed and barefoot from Merrillfield Airport,
sentences.zh: 在惊慌失措的辛迪·保尔森戴着手铐、赤着脚从梅里尔机场跑出来后不久，

sentences.en: Robert Hanson made a phone call.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·汉森打了一个电话。

sentences.en: It was around 5.30am when John Henning picked up the receiver to hear Hanson, his long-time friend, on the other line.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨5点30分，约翰·亨宁接起电话，听到了他的老朋友汉森在电话那头的声音。

sentences.en: Hanson asked if they could meet at his bakery right away.
sentences.zh: 汉森问他们是否能立刻在他的烘焙坊见面。

sentences.en: John was confused, but agreed.
sentences.zh: 约翰感到困惑，但还是同意了。

sentences.en: When John arrived, Hanson told him how his wife and children were overseas and in an effort to overcome loneliness, he had picked up a sex worker.
sentences.zh: 当约翰到达时，汉森告诉他，他的妻子和孩子在海外，为了克服孤独，他找了一名性工作者。

sentences.en: He took her back to his house, where they had sex, before she raised the price of her services.
sentences.zh: 他把她带回了家，他们发生了性关系，之后她提高了服务价格。

sentences.en: Hanson wouldn't pay and now she was seeking revenge by falsely accusing him of rape.
sentences.zh: 汉森不愿付钱，现在她正通过虚假指控他强奸来寻求报复。

sentences.en: Hanson stuttered as he spoke.
sentences.zh: 汉森说话时结结巴巴的。

sentences.en: He was clearly very anxious.
sentences.zh: 他显然非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Fearing he might be arrested, he told John he didn't want his family to find out and be hurt by his adultery.
sentences.zh: 由于担心自己会被捕，他告诉约翰，他不希望家人发现并因他的通奸行为而受到伤害。

sentences.en: He asked if John would give him an alibi for 11.30pm until 5.30am, the time frame in which Cindy Paulson was abducted, held captive and taken to the airfield.
sentences.zh: 他询问约翰是否能为他提供从晚上11点半到凌晨5点半的不在场证明，这段时间正是辛迪·保尔森被绑架、囚禁并带往机场的时间段。

sentences.en: John believed Hanson and, like many others, he dismissed the incident as a trick gone awry.
sentences.zh: 约翰相信了汉森，并且像许多其他人一样，认为这只是一个恶作剧搞砸了。

sentences.en: To help his friend, John confirmed his alibi when police came knocking.
sentences.zh: 为了帮助朋友，当警察找上门时，约翰证实了他的不在场证明。

sentences.en: As John was a well-respected local businessman, his statement was given considerable credibility.
sentences.zh: 由于约翰是一位备受尊敬的当地商人，他的证词具有相当高的可信度。

sentences.en: John had told his wife about the favour he'd done for his friend.
sentences.zh: 约翰曾告诉妻子他为朋友帮了忙。

sentences.en: As described in the book Butcher, Baker, when Joan heard that Hanson's properties were being searched, she got in her car and cruised past Hanson's residence.
sentences.zh: 正如《屠夫、面包师》一书中所述，当琼听说汉森的房产正在被搜查时，她开着车经过了汉森的住所。

sentences.en: Upon seeing the heavy police presence and speaking with officers at the scene, she realised it was time for her husband to come clean.
sentences.zh: 看到大量的警察在场并与现场警官交谈后，她意识到是时候让丈夫坦白了。

sentences.en: John Henning contacted investigators and admitted that he'd provided a false alibi for Hanson on the night of Cindy Paulson's abduction and rape.
sentences.zh: 约翰·亨宁联系了调查人员，并承认他在辛迪·保尔森被绑架和强奸的那晚为汉森提供了虚假的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Henning thought he'd been looking out for Hanson and his family by covering for him.
sentences.zh: 亨宁认为他是在为汉森打掩护，是在照顾汉森和他的家人。

sentences.en: He had no idea how serious the incident had actually been.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道这起事件实际上有多严重。

sentences.en: Despite now having no alibi for the night Cindy Paulson was attacked,
sentences.zh: 尽管现在辛迪·保尔森遇袭的那晚已经没有了不在场证明，

sentences.en: Robert Hanson still denied being involved.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·汉森仍然否认自己参与其中。

sentences.en: It didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但这已经不重要了。

sentences.en: Police had enough evidence now to charge him with Cindy's abduction and rape.
sentences.zh: 警方现在有足够的证据以绑架和强奸辛迪的罪名起诉他。

sentences.en: He was remanded on a $500,000 bond.
sentences.zh: 他被还押候审，保释金为50万美元。

sentences.en: Hanson's Old Harbour Avenue property was teeming with state troopers, searching for any evidence to link him to other crimes.
sentences.zh: 汉森在老港大道的房产里挤满了州警，他们正在搜寻任何能将他与其他罪行联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: The house's communal rooms were neat and organised.
sentences.zh: 房子的公共区域整洁有序。

sentences.en: In the living area, knick-knacks were arranged in tidy rows on shelves and plaid couches framed a small coffee table.
sentences.zh: 在起居区，小摆设在架子上排列得整整齐齐，格子沙发围着一张小咖啡桌。

sentences.en: Family photos lined the hallway, as did a portrait of Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 走廊里挂满了家庭照片，还有一幅耶稣基督的肖像。

sentences.en: Searching some cupboards, officers found elastic bandages and a bag full of cash.
sentences.zh: 在搜查一些橱柜时，警官发现了弹性绷带和一袋现金。

sentences.en: Shotguns and rifles were recovered from a closet in the living room and a hidden cabinet.
sentences.zh: 在客厅的一个壁橱和一个隐藏的柜子里发现了猎枪和步枪。

sentences.en: Given that Hanson had been previously convicted of a felony, he was forbidden by law to possess any firearMs.
sentences.zh: 鉴于汉森此前有重罪前科，法律禁止他持有任何枪支。

sentences.en: He would be charged accordingly.
sentences.zh: 他将因此受到指控。

sentences.en: There was also a strange kit that contained tools for creating disguises, including a fake moustache, nail polish and skin adhesive.
sentences.zh: 还有一个奇怪的工具包，里面装着制作伪装的工具，包括假胡子、指甲油和皮肤粘合剂。

sentences.en: A number of stolen goods were discovered, indicating Hanson's kleptomania had never gone away.
sentences.zh: 警方发现了许多赃物，这表明汉森的盗窃癖从未消失。

sentences.en: The troopers made their way downstairs to the basement, where Cindy Paulson said she'd been held captive.
sentences.zh: 警员们下到地下室，辛迪·保尔森说她曾被囚禁在那里。

sentences.en: They made their way around the room, carefully pressing against the wood-panelled walls.
sentences.zh: 他们在房间里四处走动，小心翼翼地按压着木镶板墙壁。

sentences.en: One portion suddenly gave way.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分突然松动了。

sentences.en: Behind it was a small, secret room.
sentences.zh: 后面是一个隐秘的小房间。

sentences.en: In its centre was the wooden beam Cindy had described being chained to.
sentences.zh: 房间中央就是辛迪描述的她被锁在上面的木梁。

sentences.en: After hours of meticulous searching, there was only one area left unexamined.
sentences.zh: 经过数小时的细致搜查，只剩下一个区域没有检查。

sentences.en: The attic.
sentences.zh: 阁楼。

sentences.en: One trooper offered to climb up into the small, cramped space.
sentences.zh: 一名警员主动提出爬进那个狭窄拥挤的空间。

sentences.en: Crawling across the beams, he found a stack of animal hides.
sentences.zh: 他爬过横梁，发现了一堆动物皮毛。

sentences.en: Continuing onwards, he felt with his hands for anything that might be hidden there.
sentences.zh: 继续向前，他用手摸索着可能隐藏在那里的任何东西。

sentences.en: As he pressed into some insulation in one corner, it suddenly collapsed.
sentences.zh: 当他按压角落里的隔热层时，它突然塌陷了。

sentences.en: Beneath it lay several firearms, including a .223 calibre Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
sentences.zh: 下面躺着几支枪支，包括一支.223口径的鲁格Mini-14步枪。

sentences.en: There was also a little plastic bag that contained a number of women's rings, watches and necklaces.
sentences.zh: 还有一个小塑料袋，里面装着一些女性的戒指、手表和项链。

sentences.en: One had an arrowhead pendant.
sentences.zh: 其中一个挂着箭头吊坠。

sentences.en: There was another item found in Hanson's house that was particularly noteworthy.
sentences.zh: 在汉森家中发现的另一件物品特别值得注意。

sentences.en: While examining the bedroom he shared with his wife, troopers uncovered a piece of paper stashed behind the bedhead.
sentences.zh: 在检查他与妻子共用的卧室时，警员在床头后面发现了一张纸。

sentences.en: It was an aeronautical chart, a type of map designed to assist pilots in the navigation of aircraft.
sentences.zh: 那是一张航空图，一种旨在辅助飞行员进行飞机导航的地图。

sentences.en: The map depicted a huge, sprawling overview of Anchorage and its outskirts.
sentences.zh: 地图描绘了安克雷奇及其郊区的巨大概览。

sentences.en: There was the K'nick River Valley to the north of the city, the Kenai Peninsula that jutted out below, and the port city of Seward further south.
sentences.zh: 北面是克尼克河谷，下方是突出的基奈半岛，更南面是港口城市苏厄德。

sentences.en: The map had been marked with many little black asterisks.
sentences.zh: 地图上标有许多黑色小星号。

sentences.en: Most of them were dotted along the K'nick River, though there were many others drawn further out.
sentences.zh: 它们大多点缀在克尼克河沿岸，尽管在更远的地方也画了许多。

sentences.en: As Glenn Flothie studied the map, it suddenly dawned on him.
sentences.zh: 当格伦·弗洛西研究这张地图时，他突然明白了。

sentences.en: Hanson had scrawled an asterisk on the exact locations where Aklutner Annie, Joanna Messina,
sentences.zh: 汉森在地图上用星号标出了发现阿克卢特纳·安妮、乔安娜·梅西纳、

sentences.en: Sherry Morrow and Paula Goulding were found.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·莫罗和宝拉·古尔丁的确切位置。

sentences.en: In total, his map featured 21 such markings.
sentences.zh: 总共，他的地图上有21个这样的标记。

sentences.en: Although Hanson was still only charged with abducting and raping Cindy Paulson, the case was already starting to look like the biggest Alaska had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 尽管汉森当时只被指控绑架和强奸了辛迪·保尔森，但此案已经开始看起来像是阿拉斯加有史以来最大的案件。

sentences.en: Investigators had more evidence of the enormity of his crimes, including Hanson's Ruger rifle,
sentences.zh: 调查人员掌握了更多他罪行严重的证据，包括汉森的鲁格步枪，

sentences.en: which was confirmed to have fired the bullets that killed Sherry Morrow and Paula Goulding.
sentences.zh: 经证实，该枪发射的子弹杀害了雪莉·莫罗和宝拉·古尔丁。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the friends and families of women missing from Anchorage's Tenderloin district had been shown the items of jewellery hidden in Hanson's attic,
sentences.zh: 此外，安克雷奇红灯区失踪女性的亲友们被展示了藏在汉森阁楼里的珠宝，

sentences.en: many of which were recognised as having belonged to their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 其中许多被认出是属于她们所爱之人的。

sentences.en: The arrowhead pendant was the spitting image of a necklace that Sherry Morrow was known to wear every single day.
sentences.zh: 那个箭头吊坠与雪莉·莫罗每天佩戴的项链一模一样。

sentences.en: Business cards that featured the names of some of the missing women were also discovered in Hanson's garage.
sentences.zh: 在汉森的车库里还发现了印有部分失踪女性名字的名片。

sentences.en: Prior to Hanson's arrest, a renowned criminal profiler had stated that the person responsible for the murders would be collecting keepsakes from each of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在汉森被捕前，一位著名的犯罪侧写师曾表示，谋杀案的肇事者会从每位受害者身上收集纪念品。

sentences.en: Like a trophy hunter hoarding parts of the animal they had killed as a representation of their success and to relive the hunt from memory.
sentences.zh: 就像战利品猎人囤积猎杀动物的部位，以此作为成功的象征，并从记忆中重温狩猎过程。

sentences.en: With the evidence against Hanson adding up, it was believed he could be compelled to confess.
sentences.zh: 随着针对汉森的证据不断增加，人们相信他可能会被迫认罪。

sentences.en: After some negotiating, a deal was struck with his attorney.
sentences.zh: 经过一番谈判，他与律师达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: If Hanson pleaded guilty to the murders of Aklutner Annie,
sentences.zh: 如果汉森对谋杀阿克卢特纳·安妮、

sentences.en: Joanna Messina, Sherry Morrow and Paula Goulding, then his wife and children would be spared the humiliation and pain of a highly publicised trial.
sentences.zh: 乔安娜·梅西纳、雪莉·莫罗和宝拉·古尔丁的罪行认罪，那么他的妻子和孩子将免受备受瞩目的审判带来的羞辱和痛苦。

sentences.en: The case would be wrapped up quickly so as to receive little attention from the media and Hanson could serve out his sentence in a federal penitentiary.
sentences.zh: 案件将迅速了结，以免引起媒体的过多关注，汉森可以在联邦监狱服刑。

sentences.en: On February 22, 1984,
Hanson's attorney escorted him to a meeting with the prosecution team so he could provide a full confession.
sentences.zh: 汉森的律师陪同他与检方团队会面，以便他能进行全面坦白。

sentences.en: Hanson couldn't provide Aklutner Annie's true identity, but he said she was his first murder victim.
sentences.zh: 汉森无法提供阿克卢特纳·安妮的真实身份，但他称她是他的第一个谋杀受害者。

sentences.en: He'd picked her up from downtown Anchorage and stabbed her to death north of the city.
sentences.zh: 他在安克雷奇市中心接上她，并在城北将她刺死。

sentences.en: Joanna Messina from Seward was his second.
sentences.zh: 来自苏厄德的乔安娜·梅西纳是第二个。

sentences.en: Hanson killed her upon realising she was a sex worker who had no genuine interest in him.
sentences.zh: 汉森在意识到她是一名对他没有真正兴趣的性工作者后杀害了她。

sentences.en: Posing as a high-paying photographer,
sentences.zh: 汉森伪装成一名高薪摄影师，

sentences.en: Hanson lured Sherry Morrow, the first woman he took out to his Kinnick River Valley hunting grounds.
sentences.zh: 诱骗了雪莉·莫罗，她是第一个被他带到克尼克河谷狩猎场的女性。

sentences.en: Upon reaching the sandbar that spanned the river,
sentences.zh: 到达横跨河流的沙洲后，

sentences.en: Hanson brought his car to a stop and pulled Sherry out.
sentences.zh: 汉森停下车，把雪莉拉了出来。

sentences.en: She wasn't cooperating, so Hanson retrieved his rifle and sat under a tree waiting for her to settle.
sentences.zh: 她不配合，于是汉森取回步枪，坐在树下等着她安静下来。

sentences.en: According to Hanson,
sentences.zh: 据汉森说，

sentences.en: Sherry stood over him, kicking and screaming, which prompted him to point the rifle up and shoot her.
sentences.zh: 雪莉站在他上方，又踢又叫，这促使他举起步枪射杀了她。

sentences.en: This claim contradicted evidence from the crime scene, which showed Sherry was blindfolded and had been shot three times in the back.
sentences.zh: 这一说法与犯罪现场的证据相矛盾，证据显示雪莉被蒙住双眼，背部中了三枪。

sentences.en: After burying Sherry in the silt and sand,
sentences.zh: 在将雪莉埋在淤泥和沙子中后，

sentences.en: Hanson left with her arrowhead necklace as a keepsake.
sentences.zh: 汉森带着她的箭头项链作为纪念品离开了。

sentences.en: Paula Goulding suffered a similar fate in the valley.
sentences.zh: 宝拉·古尔丁在山谷中遭遇了同样的命运。

sentences.en: Then there was survivor Cindy Paulson, who Hanson finally admitted to abducting and raping.
sentences.zh: 然后是幸存者辛迪·保尔森，汉森最终承认绑架并强奸了她。

sentences.en: He also admitted to the murder of Andrea Altieri, a dancer who had vanished after meeting a man who was going to take her on a shopping spree.
sentences.zh: 他还承认谋杀了安德里亚·阿尔蒂耶里，一名舞者，她在遇到一个说要带她去疯狂购物的男人后失踪了。

sentences.en: Andrea wore a custom-made necklace that featured a pendant in the shape of a fish, given to her by a friend.
sentences.zh: 安德里亚戴着一条定制项链，上面有一个朋友送给她的鱼形吊坠。

sentences.en: It was found among the jewellery stored in Hanson's attic.
sentences.zh: 它在汉森阁楼存放的珠宝中被发现。

sentences.en: Hanson said he abducted Andrea just two weeks after he killed Sherry Morrow.
sentences.zh: 汉森说他在杀害雪莉·莫罗两周后就绑架了安德里亚。

sentences.en: He had driven Andrea, blindfolded and handcuffed, to the Kinnick Valley area and pulled up to an isolated spot near a railroad bridge.
sentences.zh: 他开车将蒙着眼睛、戴着手铐的安德里亚带到克尼克河谷地区，停在铁路桥附近的一个偏僻地点。

sentences.en: Hanson had brought another woman there a week prior and raped her, but ultimately let her go.
sentences.zh: 汉森一周前曾带另一个女人到那里并强奸了她，但最终放了她。

sentences.en: Andrea endured a similar experience, though hers ended fatally.
sentences.zh: 安德里亚经历了类似的遭遇，但她的结局是致命的。

sentences.en: Hanson claimed Andrea had reached for his pistol, causing them to scuffle.
sentences.zh: 汉森声称安德里亚伸手去拿他的手枪，导致他们发生了争执。

sentences.en: Hanson pried it from her grasp and as the fight continued,
sentences.zh: 汉森从她手中夺过枪，在打斗继续时，

sentences.en: Andrea put her fingers behind Hanson's glasses and pressed them into his eye sockets.
sentences.zh: 安德里亚把手指伸到汉森的眼镜后面，按进了他的眼窝。

sentences.en: In response, Hanson shot her dead.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，汉森开枪打死了她。

sentences.en: He filled a duffel bag with gravel and tied it around Andrea's neck before pushing her body off the railroad bridge into the Kinnick River below.
sentences.zh: 他装满了一个装满碎石的行李袋，系在安德里亚的脖子上，然后把她的尸体从铁路桥推入下方的克尼克河。

sentences.en: After Hanson concluded his detailed confession,
sentences.zh: 在汉森结束他详细的供述后，

sentences.en: District Attorney Victor Crumb stood.
sentences.zh: 地方检察官维克多·克拉姆站了起来。

sentences.en: In a no-nonsense tone,
sentences.zh: 用一种严肃的语气，

sentences.en: Crumb informed Hanson that they knew he hadn't been completely honest with them.
sentences.zh: 克拉姆告诉汉森，他们知道他并没有对他们完全诚实。

sentences.en: Hanson's aviation map indicated he had killed many more women.
sentences.zh: 汉森的航空地图显示他杀害了更多女性。

sentences.en: The forests were covered with winter snow, but as soon as spring arrived and the ice thawed,
sentences.zh: 森林被冬雪覆盖，但一旦春天到来，冰雪融化，

sentences.en: state troopers would be taking sniffer dogs out to every area marked on the map until they found the rest of Hanson's victiMs.
sentences.zh: 州警将带着嗅探犬前往地图上标记的每一个区域，直到找到汉森其余的受害者。

sentences.en: DA Crumb snapped.
sentences.zh: 克拉姆检察官厉声说道。

sentences.en: If you think this is the end, we're gonna prosecute you on every one of these cases.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这就是结束，我们将就这些案件中的每一个起诉你。

sentences.en: There's gonna be a trial for everything.
sentences.zh: 每一件事都要进行审判。

sentences.en: The ordinarily meek and mild-mannered Hanson turned bright red.
sentences.zh: 平时温顺随和的汉森脸色变得通红。

sentences.en: He looked furious.
sentences.zh: 他看起来非常愤怒。

sentences.en: In a low voice,
sentences.zh: 压低声音，

sentences.en: Hanson muttered, quote,
sentences.zh: 汉森嘟囔着，引用道，

sentences.en: Dirty fuckin' whores.
sentences.zh: 肮脏的婊子们。

sentences.en: Finally, the prosecutors were getting a real look at the man who had attacked and murdered so many women.
sentences.zh: 终于，检察官们真正看清了这个袭击并谋杀了这么多女性的男人。

sentences.en: Another deal was hastily arranged.
sentences.zh: 另一项协议匆忙达成。

sentences.en: If Hanson provided further confessions and assisted state troopers in locating his remaining victims, then he would only be charged with the four murders he'd already admitted to.
sentences.zh: 如果汉森提供进一步的供述并协助州警找到他其余的受害者，那么他将只被指控他已经承认的四起谋杀案。

sentences.en: He agreed.
sentences.zh: 他同意了。

sentences.en: Hanson claimed to have killed 17 women, not the 21 investigators suspected due to his map.
sentences.zh: 汉森声称杀害了17名女性，而不是调查人员根据他的地图怀疑的21名。

sentences.en: His victims were always vulnerable women from the Tenderloin district, whose disappearances would be easily overlooked or disregarded by authorities.
sentences.zh: 他的受害者总是红灯区的弱势女性，她们的失踪很容易被当局忽视或无视。

sentences.en: This systemic prejudice had ensured that Hanson maintained his killing streak without fear of apprehension.
sentences.zh: 这种系统性的偏见确保了汉森在没有被捕风险的情况下保持了他的杀戮狂潮。

sentences.en: Hanson liked to big-note himself to the women he abducted, sometimes telling them he was a doctor or a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 汉森喜欢在绑架的女性面前吹嘘自己，有时告诉她们他是医生或律师。

sentences.en: He lured them with large amounts of money, knowing it would be difficult for them to refuse.
sentences.zh: 他用大量的金钱引诱她们，知道她们很难拒绝。

sentences.en: Hanson tried to convince those questioning him that he wasn't the misogynist they thought he was, explaining that he only targeted women who he felt were inferior to him.
sentences.zh: 汉森试图说服审讯他的人，他并不是他们认为的那种厌女症患者，解释说他只针对他认为不如他的女性。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用道，

sentences.en: I'm not saying that I hate all women, I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不是说我恨所有女人，我没有。

sentences.en: Quite to the contrary.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I guess in my own mind what I'm classifying is a good woman, not a prostitute.
sentences.zh: 我想在我自己的心里，我所定义的是好女人，而不是妓女。

sentences.en: I'd do everything in my power, any way, shape or form, to do anything for her and to see that no harm ever came to her.
sentences.zh: 我会尽我所能，以任何方式、形式，为她做任何事，并确保她永远不会受到伤害。

sentences.en: But I guess prostitutes are women I'm putting down as lower than myself.
sentences.zh: 但我猜妓女是我认为比我低贱的女性。

sentences.en: He assured his interrogators that he hadn't killed every woman he abducted.
sentences.zh: 他向审讯人员保证，他并没有杀害他绑架的每一个女人。

sentences.en: As long as they went along with what he wanted, he felt fine about letting them live.
sentences.zh: 只要她们顺从他的意愿，他就觉得放她们活命没问题。

sentences.en: When they put up a fight or tried to flee, he felt the need to kill, explaining,
sentences.zh: 当她们反抗或试图逃跑时，他觉得有必要杀人，解释道，

sentences.en: I guess I wanted to control things.
sentences.zh: 我想我是想控制一切。

sentences.en: Even though Hansen couldn't remember many of his murder victims' names, the sites where they were buried were still fresh on his mind.
sentences.zh: 尽管汉森记不清许多谋杀受害者的名字，但埋葬她们的地点在他脑海中依然清晰。

sentences.en: He was flown to the areas he'd marked on his map and, according to the book
sentences.zh: 他被空运到他在地图上标记的区域，据《公平游戏》一书所述，

sentences.en: Fair Game,
sentences.zh: 《公平游戏》，

sentences.en: Hansen became noticeably thrilled and exhilarated traversing his former hunting grounds.
sentences.zh: 汉森在穿越他以前的狩猎场时表现得明显兴奋和激动。

sentences.en: He triumphantly pointed out where he had left each victim and, quote,
sentences.zh: 他得意洋洋地指出他把每个受害者留在了哪里，并引用道，

sentences.en: A couple of times he became so excited he dropped to his knees to dig in the snow with his hands, looking wide-eyed and with a smile on his flushed, pockmarked face.
sentences.zh: 有几次他太兴奋了，跪在地上用手在雪里挖，睁大眼睛，红肿、坑坑洼洼的脸上带着微笑。

sentences.en: Those accompanying Hansen were disturbed and angered by his behaviour, promising themselves this would be the last time the killer would ever step foot in the Alaskan wilderness
sentences.zh: 那些陪同汉森的人对他的行为感到不安和愤怒，他们向自己保证，这将是这个杀手最后一次踏上阿拉斯加荒野，

sentences.en: that he so clearly adored.
sentences.zh: 那片他显然非常钟爱的土地。

sentences.en: They marked each and every gravesite, then waited patiently for spring so that they could start digging.
sentences.zh: 他们标记了每一个坟墓，然后耐心地等待春天，以便开始挖掘。

sentences.en: Tuesday, April 24, 1984 marked the first day of the search for Robert Hansen's remaining victiMs.
sentences.zh: 1984年4月24日星期二，标志着搜寻罗伯特·汉森其余受害者的第一天。

sentences.en: With shovels in hand, groups of Alaska state troopers gathered around the spots marked on Hansen's map or pointed out by him directly and began digging.
sentences.zh: 阿拉斯加州警小组手持铁锹，聚集在汉森地图上标记或他直接指出的地点，开始挖掘。

sentences.en: On that day, two bodies were found.
sentences.zh: 那天，发现了两具尸体。

sentences.en: 22-year-old Sue Luna was uncovered by a creek on the Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 22岁的苏·卢娜在克尼克河的一条小溪边被发现。

sentences.en: 28-year-old Malay Larson was in a parking area downriver, a short distance from the old Kinnick Bridge.
sentences.zh: 28岁的马来·拉尔森在下游的一个停车场，距离旧克尼克桥不远。

sentences.en: Over the next couple of days, a further two victims were recovered.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，又发现了两名受害者。

sentences.en: The first was an unknown woman found by Horseshoe Lake further inland and to the northwest of Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 第一个是一名身份不明的女性，在克尼克河西北部更内陆的马蹄湖边被发现。

sentences.en: Aged between 17 and 21 years old, she had been shot and stabbed.
sentences.zh: 年龄在17到21岁之间，她被枪杀并刺伤。

sentences.en: She was white with brown hair and dressed in jeans, a sweater, a coat, scarf, and tennis shoes.
sentences.zh: 她是白人，棕色头发，穿着牛仔裤、毛衣、外套、围巾和网球鞋。

sentences.en: Hansen couldn't recall her name and despite efforts, investigators were unable to formally identify her.
sentences.zh: 汉森无法回忆起她的名字，尽管调查人员付出了努力，却始终无法正式确认她的身份。

sentences.en: Like a Klootner Annie, they named this victim after the area where she was found.
sentences.zh: 就像“克卢特纳安妮”一样，他们以发现这名受害者的地点来为她命名。

sentences.en: Horseshoe Harriet.
sentences.zh: “马蹄铁哈丽特”。

sentences.en: The second body was that of 24-year-old
sentences.zh: 第二具尸体是24岁的

sentences.en: Angela Fedden.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉·费登。

sentences.en: Scavenging animals had reduced her remains to just a jawbone.
sentences.zh: 食腐动物的啃食使她的遗骸仅剩下一块下颌骨。

sentences.en: Three days later,
sentences.zh: 三天后，

sentences.en: 20-year-old Tammy Peterson was found on an island in the middle of the Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 20岁的塔米·彼得森在基尼克河中央的一座岛屿上被发现。

sentences.en: 41-year-old Lisa Fertrell was next on May 9, located south of the old Kinnick Bridge.
sentences.zh: 5月9日，41岁的丽莎·弗特雷尔在旧基尼克桥以南被发现。

sentences.en: Just over one week later,
sentences.zh: 仅仅一周多后，

sentences.en: 22-year-old Teresa Watson was found at Scenic Lake,
sentences.zh: 22岁的特蕾莎·沃森在风景湖被发现，

sentences.en: 30 miles southwest west of Anchorage.
sentences.zh: 位于安克雷奇西南方30英里处。

sentences.en: Bloodhounds were taken to the remaining grave sites pinpointed by Robert Hansen, but had no luck finding anything.
sentences.zh: 警犬被带到罗伯特·汉森指出的其余埋尸地点，但没能找到任何线索。

sentences.en: It was believed that if there were indeed bodies there at one point, they might have since been scavenged by animals or swept away by heavy rains in the sand and silt.
sentences.zh: 人们认为，如果那里曾经确实有尸体，它们可能已经被动物啃食，或者被大雨冲进了沙砾之中。

sentences.en: In August the following year of 1985, an amateur pilot testing out his aircraft's new tyres came into land along the sandbar spanning the Kinnick River.
sentences.zh: 次年，即1985年8月，一名业余飞行员在测试飞机的轮胎时，降落在了横跨基尼克河的沙洲上。

sentences.en: The area was no longer
sentences.zh: 这片区域不再是

sentences.en: Robert Hansen's hunting ground, but his presence still remained.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·汉森的狩猎场，但他的阴影依然存在。

sentences.en: While there, the pilot discovered human remains.
sentences.zh: 在停留期间，飞行员发现了人类遗骸。

sentences.en: Two handmade rings found on the body led to an identification.
